purpose: Machine-readable comparison and visual gate settings for fidelity runs. Agents must copy these into loop.json / manifest and must not invent looser numbers after seeing results.

notes: Pixels with Euclidean RGB distance above inspectionThreshold are counted as beyond.
This alone is not a complete PASS rule for the declared profile.

requiredForProfilePass: Documented aggregate fractionBeyond (or equivalent) acceptance bound for the declared observation window
Documented local-region / material-content review rule (missing subject, wrong paint, large pose drift cannot pass on low aggregate alone)
Alpha / background compositing rules (declared backgrounds #101014 Lottie, #000000 SVG)
Operator approval of the above bounds
whileUnverified: Continue diagnose/implement against inspection metrics and human strip review
Report VISUAL_UNVERIFIED; do not claim profile visual PASS
Do not widen inspectionThreshold or invent aggregate bounds after seeing diffs

reference.browser: Resolve via evaluation/harness/chrome.ts (GVR_CHROME / CHROME_PATH, then platform defaults). Record the resolved binary and --version in environment.json.
